screener.text: Before we start: is any of this happening right now?

items.label: Someone is unresponsive or not breathing normally
One side of the face is drooping
Slurred speech, or trouble speaking or understanding
Sudden weakness or numbness on one side of the body, or sudden confusion
Struggling to breathe, or can't speak a full sentence
Chest pain or pressure with sweating, or spreading to the arm, jaw, or back
Swelling of the face, lips, or throat, or trouble breathing after a sting, food, or medicine
Heavy bleeding that won't stop after 10 minutes of firm pressure
Overdose, poisoning, or swallowing something dangerous
Stopped drinking heavily and now have severe shaking, seizures, or hallucinations
Thoughts of suicide, or of hurting yourself or someone else
Someone has hurt you, or you don't feel safe

modifier_questions.text: Does the pain spread to your arm, shoulder, neck, jaw, or back?
modifier_questions.why: Pain that spreads can be a sign of a heart problem.

modifier_questions.text: Are you sweating heavily or feeling clammy for no clear reason?
modifier_questions.why: Cold sweats with chest or jaw pain can signal a heart problem.

modifier_questions.text: Are you short of breath even while sitting still?
modifier_questions.why: Breathlessness at rest is more concerning than breathlessness with effort.

modifier_questions.text: Is it hard to say a full sentence without stopping for breath?
modifier_questions.why: This helps tell how severe the breathing problem is.

modifier_questions.text: Does your throat feel tight, or is it hard to swallow or breathe?
modifier_questions.why: Throat tightness can mean a dangerous allergic reaction.

modifier_questions.text: Is this the first seizure you've ever had?
modifier_questions.why: A first seizure needs urgent evaluation.

modifier_questions.text: Is this the worst headache of your life?
modifier_questions.why: A sudden, severe headache can signal bleeding in the brain.

modifier_questions.text: Did it start suddenly, reaching full strength within a few minutes?
modifier_questions.why: Sudden onset can point to a more serious cause.

modifier_questions.text: Is your neck so stiff that bringing your chin to your chest hurts?
modifier_questions.why: Fever or headache with a stiff neck can signal meningitis.

modifier_questions.text: Is one or both of your legs weak or giving way?
modifier_questions.why: Back pain with leg weakness can mean nerve compression.

modifier_questions.text: Any loss of bladder or bowel control, or numbness around your groin or inner thighs?
modifier_questions.why: These can be signs of serious nerve compression that needs urgent care.

modifier_questions.text: Is the bleeding heavy, for example soaking a pad every hour or not slowing with pressure?
modifier_questions.why: Heavy bleeding can become dangerous quickly.

modifier_questions.text: Is your belly hard as a board, or too painful to touch?
modifier_questions.why: A rigid, tender belly can signal a serious problem inside the abdomen.

modifier_questions.text: Are you unable to pass urine?
modifier_questions.why: Not being able to urinate needs prompt care.

modifier_questions.text: Did you black out, even briefly, after the injury?
modifier_questions.why: Losing consciousness after a head injury can signal a brain injury.

modifier_questions.text: Have you vomited more than once since the injury?
modifier_questions.why: Repeated vomiting after a head injury can be a warning sign.

modifier_questions.text: Is the burn larger than the palm of your hand?
modifier_questions.why: Larger burns need medical care.

modifier_questions.text: Is the burn on your face, or did you breathe in smoke or hot air?
modifier_questions.why: Burns near the airway can cause breathing problems later.

modifier_questions.text: Was it caused by a chemical or electricity?
modifier_questions.why: These burns can be deeper than they look.

modifier_questions.text: Is the swelling in only one leg?
modifier_questions.why: Swelling in just one leg can be a sign of a blood clot.

modifier_questions.text: Are you unable to keep fluids down?
modifier_questions.why: Not keeping fluids down can lead to dehydration.

context_questions.text: Do you take a blood thinner, such as warfarin, apixaban (Eliquis), rivaroxaban (Xarelto), or clopidogrel (Plavix)?
context_questions.why: Blood thinners make bleeding after a head injury more dangerous.

context_questions.text: Is your immune system weakened, for example from chemotherapy, a transplant, long-term steroids, or HIV?
context_questions.why: Fever can be more serious when the immune system is weakened.
